XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure of front windshield wiper with regular windshield washer operation
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | B1018 | B1016 | B1050 | BODY | COMPUTER | WORKING | INACTIVE | FRONT | WIPERS | WIPER BLADES | WIPER BLADE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Body computer

  • Fault: Occasional failure of front windscreen wipers. Rear windscreen wipers operating normally

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • B1018 (Low-speed windscreen wiper control circuit – Fault)
    • B1016 (High-speed windscreen wiper control circuit – Fault)
    • B1050 (Windscreen wiper control circuit – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty body computer

• Procedure: Check the condition and correct operation of the body computer and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the passenger compartment, on the driver’s side beneath the steering wheel on the left, connected to the fuse box.
    No reprogramming using diagnostic equipment was required following the replacement.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 1.7 hours.

    Problems with this component are quite common on this model.
